title: Logotype / Minimum sizes
slide_intent: Set a lower size boundary because recognition fails when lettering becomes too small to read.
strategic_value: Separate screen and print minima can preserve Duolingo’s signature across media.
demonstration: Two logotype examples label screen width at 100 px and print width at 35 mm / 1.375 in, beside a legibility rule.
practical_value: Check the wordmark’s width against the minimum for its medium.

content_islands.name: Screen and print minima
content_islands.spec: Pair the screen and print specimens within the left panel, retaining their 100 px and 35 mm / 1.375 in labels.

content_islands.name: Legibility rule
content_islands.spec: Keep the section heading and never-smaller instruction at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy states that the logotype should always be legible.
reference_purposes.Application: Separate screen and print examples show the specified minima.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source prohibits sizes below 100 px on screen or 35 mm / 1.375 in in print.

ingredient.name: Logotype minimum width
ingredient.application: Keep width at least 100 px on screen or 35 mm / 1.375 in in print.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Minimum width for the historical logotype, not a universal minimum for every brand mark.
